 10948	/-! ### 6.4: the real-smooth quotient-compact core
 10949	
 10950	The existing manifold instance on `ℍ` is complex.  Using `CMDiff` for the
 10951	paper's smooth Maass-type functions would therefore impose holomorphicity and
 10952	would collapse a compactly supported core.  We use the same open chart with
 10953	the real model `ℂ ≃ ℝ²` and define genuine real `C∞` smoothness.
 10954	-/
 10955	
 10956	namespace SmoothCompactCoreGeometry
 10957	
 10958	open MeasureTheory Set Function Topology
 10959	open scoped Manifold ContDiff
 10960	open HalfIntegralMultiplier GammaTwoQuotientGeometry
 10961	
 10962	/-- Pull a function back to the open upper half-plane chart in `ℂ`. -/
 10963	noncomputable def upperLift (u : ℍ → ℂ) : ℂ → ℂ :=
 10964	  u ∘ UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex
 10965	
 10966	@[simp]
 10967	theorem upperLift_apply (u : ℍ → ℂ) (z : ℍ) :
 10968	    upperLift u (z : ℂ) = u z := by
 10969	  simp [upperLift, Function.comp_def]
 10970	
 10971	/-- Real `C∞` smoothness, as opposed to complex analyticity. -/
 10972	def RealSmooth (u : ℍ → ℂ) : Prop :=
 10973	  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (upperLift u) UpperHalfPlane.upperHalfPlaneSet
 10974	
 10975	theorem realSmooth_zero : RealSmooth (0 : ℍ → ℂ) := by
 10976	  simpa [RealSmooth, upperLift, Function.comp_def] using
 10977	    (contDiffOn_const : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
 10978	      (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) UpperHalfPlane.upperHalfPlaneSet)
 10979	
 10980	namespace RealSmooth
 10981	
 10982	theorem add {u v : ℍ → ℂ} (hu : RealSmooth u) (hv : RealSmooth v) :
 10983	    RealSmooth (u + v) := by
 10984	  unfold RealSmooth at hu hv ⊢
 10985	  simpa [upperLift, Function.comp_def] using hu.add hv
 10986	
 10987	theorem neg {u : ℍ → ℂ} (hu : RealSmooth u) :
 10988	    RealSmooth (-u) := by
 10989	  unfold RealSmooth at hu ⊢
 10990	  simpa [upperLift, Function.comp_def] using hu.neg
 10991	
 10992	theorem sub {u v : ℍ → ℂ} (hu : RealSmooth u) (hv : RealSmooth v) :
 10993	    RealSmooth (u - v) := by
 10994	  unfold RealSmooth at hu hv ⊢
 10995	  simpa [upperLift, Function.comp_def] using hu.sub hv
 10996	
 10997	/-- Fixed complex multiplication is real-linear and real-smooth. -/
 10998	theorem const_complex_smul (c : ℂ) {u : ℍ → ℂ} (hu : RealSmooth u) :
 10999	    RealSmooth (c • u) := by
 11000	  unfold RealSmooth at hu ⊢
 11001	  simpa [upperLift, Function.comp_def] using hu.const_smul c
 11002	
 11003	theorem continuous {u : ℍ → ℂ} (hu : RealSmooth u) : Continuous u := by
 11004	  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
 11005	  intro z
 11006	  unfold RealSmooth at hu
 11007	  have hWithin := (hu (z : ℂ) z.im_pos).continuousWithinAt
 11008	  have hAt : ContinuousAt (upperLift u) (z : ℂ) :=
 11009	    hWithin.continuousAt
 11010	      (UpperHalfPlane.isOpen_upperHalfPlaneSet.mem_nhds z.im_pos)
 11011	  have hcomp := hAt.comp' UpperHalfPlane.continuous_coe.continuousAt
 11012	  simpa [upperLift, Function.comp_def] using hcomp
 11013	
 11014	theorem measurable {u : ℍ → ℂ} (hu : RealSmooth u) : Measurable u :=
 11015	  hu.continuous.measurable
 11016	
 11017	end RealSmooth
 11018	
 11019	/-- Topological support on the quotient.  The closure is important: it is the
 11020	downstairs analogue of `tsupport`, and it makes compact support stable under
 11021	addition and scalar multiplication. -/
 11022	def quotientTSupport (u : ℍ → ℂ) : Set GammaTwoQuotient :=
 11023	  closure (gammaTwoQuotientMk '' Function.support u)
 11024	
 11025	/-- A lifted automorphic function is compactly supported modulo `Gamma(2)`. -/
 11026	def HasQuotientCompactSupport (u : ℍ → ℂ) : Prop :=
 11027	  IsCompact (quotientTSupport u)
 11028	
 11029	@[simp]
 11030	theorem quotientTSupport_zero :
 11031	    quotientTSupport (0 : ℍ → ℂ) = ∅ := by
 11032	  simp [quotientTSupport]
 11033	
 11034	theorem quotientTSupport_add_subset (u v : ℍ → ℂ) :
 11035	    quotientTSupport (u + v) ⊆ quotientTSupport u ∪ quotientTSupport v := by
 11036	  apply closure_minimal
 11037	  · rintro q ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
 11038	    rcases Function.support_add u v hz with hz | hz
 11039	    · exact Or.inl (subset_closure ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩)
 11040	    · exact Or.inr (subset_closure ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩)
 11041	  · exact isClosed_closure.union isClosed_closure
 11042	
 11043	theorem quotientTSupport_smul_subset (c : ℂ) (u : ℍ → ℂ) :
 11044	    quotientTSupport (c • u) ⊆ quotientTSupport u := by
 11045	  apply closure_minimal
 11046	  · rintro q ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
 11047	    exact subset_closure
 11048	      ⟨z, Function.support_const_smul_subset c u hz, rfl⟩
 11049	  · exact isClosed_closure
 11050	
 11051	/-- Multiplication by an arbitrary second factor cannot enlarge quotient
 11052	support.  No automorphy or regularity of the second factor is needed. -/
 11053	theorem quotientTSupport_mul_subset_left_general (u v : ℍ → ℂ) :
 11054	    quotientTSupport (u * v) ⊆ quotientTSupport u := by
 11055	  apply closure_minimal
 11056	  · rintro q ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
 11057	    exact subset_closure
 11058	      ⟨z, Function.support_mul_subset_left u v hz, rfl⟩
 11059	  · exact isClosed_closure
 11060	
 11061	namespace HasQuotientCompactSupport
 11062	
 11063	theorem zero : HasQuotientCompactSupport (0 : ℍ → ℂ) := by
 11064	  simp [HasQuotientCompactSupport]
 11065	
 11066	theorem add {u v : ℍ → ℂ}
 11067	    (hu : HasQuotientCompactSupport u)
 11068	    (hv : HasQuotientCompactSupport v) :
 11069	    HasQuotientCompactSupport (u + v) :=
 11070	  (hu.union hv).of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure
 11071	    (quotientTSupport_add_subset u v)
 11072	
 11073	theorem smul (c : ℂ) {u : ℍ → ℂ}
 11074	    (hu : HasQuotientCompactSupport u) :
 11075	    HasQuotientCompactSupport (c • u) :=
 11076	  hu.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure
 11077	    (quotientTSupport_smul_subset c u)

 11080	quotient-compact. -/

 11083	    HasQuotientCompactSupport (u * v) :=

 12992	/-- The analytic domain common to all three raw operators: real-smooth
 12993	functions with compact support on the effective quotient.  No covariance is
 12994	asserted at this layer. -/
 12995	def smoothQuotientCompactSubmodule : Submodule ℂ SmoothFunction where
 12996	  carrier := {f | HasQuotientCompactSupport (f : ℍ → ℂ)}
 12997	  zero_mem' := by
 12998	    change HasQuotientCompactSupport (0 : ℍ → ℂ)
 12999	    exact HasQuotientCompactSupport.zero
 13000	  add_mem' := by
 13001	    rintro u v hu hv
 13002	    change HasQuotientCompactSupport
 13003	      ((u : ℍ → ℂ) + (v : ℍ → ℂ))
 13004	    exact hu.add hv
 13005	  smul_mem' := by
 13006	    rintro c u hu
 13007	    change HasQuotientCompactSupport (c • (u : ℍ → ℂ))
 13008	    exact hu.smul c
 13009	
 13010	abbrev SmoothQuotientCompactFunction := smoothQuotientCompactSubmodule
 13011	
 13012	/-- Evaluate a smooth quotient-compact function without relying on a
 13013	multi-step coercion through `SmoothFunction`. -/
 13014	instance : CoeFun SmoothQuotientCompactFunction (fun _ => ℍ → ℂ) where
 13015	  coe f := (f.1 : ℍ → ℂ)

 13018	domain. -/

 13023	    (fun f => by

 13025	      exact HasQuotientCompactSupport.raiseRaw f.2 a)

 13070	/-- The universal extra term in the raising-chain-rule calculation when the
 13071	operator coefficient `r` differs from the covariance exponent `q`. -/
 13072	def raisingCovarianceDefect
 13073	    (q r c nu jPow u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
 13074	  2 * Complex.I * c * (q - r) * nu * jPow * u
 13075	
 13076	theorem raisingCovarianceDefect_eq_zero_of_coefficient_eq
 13077	    (q c nu jPow u : ℂ) :
 13078	    raisingCovarianceDefect q q c nu jPow u = 0 := by
 13079	  simp [raisingCovarianceDefect]
 13080	
 13081	/-- For the PDF's exponent `q=-1/2` and displayed coefficient `r=+1/2`,
 13082	the chain-rule defect is generally nonzero. -/
 13083	theorem paperDisplayedRaising_defect
 13084	    (c nu jPow u : ℂ) :
 13085	    raisingCovarianceDefect (-1 / 2) (1 / 2) c nu jPow u =
 13086	      -2 * Complex.I * c * nu * jPow * u := by
 13087	  simp [raisingCovarianceDefect]
 13088	  ring
 13089	
 13090	theorem paperDisplayedRaising_defect_ne_zero
 13091	    {c nu jPow u : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hnu : nu ≠ 0)
 13092	    (hj : jPow ≠ 0) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
 13093	    raisingCovarianceDefect (-1 / 2) (1 / 2) c nu jPow u ≠ 0 := by
 13094	  rw [paperDisplayedRaising_defect]
 13095	  exact mul_ne_zero
 13096	    (mul_ne_zero
 13097	      (mul_ne_zero
 13098	        (mul_ne_zero
 13099	          (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Complex.I_ne_zero) hc)
 13100	        hnu)
 13101	      hj)
 13102	    hu
 13103

 13105	def paperDisplayedExponentIndex : ℤ :=
 13106	  -1

 13113	/-- Reindex the paper certificate by the actual doubled covariance exponent. -/

 14510	/-- Induction on an arbitrary finite `R/L` word.  Thus the all-word predicate
 14511	is a theorem from zeroth-word covariance, not an extra certificate carried by
 14512	the example. -/
 14513	theorem FixedPhaseDifferentialWord.eval_covariant
 14514	    (word : FixedPhaseDifferentialWord) {n : ℤ}

 14517	    IsInverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant
 14518	      (FixedPhaseDifferentialWord.targetIndex n word)
 14519	      (FixedPhaseDifferentialWord.eval n word f) := by
 14520	  induction word generalizing n f with
 14521	  | nil => simpa using hf
 14522	  | raise tail ih =>
 14523	      rw [FixedPhaseDifferentialWord.eval_raise_apply,
 14524	        FixedPhaseDifferentialWord.targetIndex_raise]
 14525	      exact ih hf.raiseRaw
 14526	  | lower tail ih =>
 14527	      rw [FixedPhaseDifferentialWord.eval_lower_apply,
 14528	        FixedPhaseDifferentialWord.targetIndex_lower]
 14529	      exact ih hf.lowerRaw
 14530	
 14531	/-- The maximal smooth quotient-compact submodule stable under every finite
 14532	word in the concrete fixed-phase raising and lowering operators. -/
 14533	noncomputable def inverseEtaFixedPhaseStableCoreSubmodule (n : ℤ) :
 14534	    Submodule ℂ SmoothQuotientCompactFunction where
 14535	  carrier := {f | ∀ word : FixedPhaseDifferentialWord,
 14536	    IsInverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant
 14537	      (FixedPhaseDifferentialWord.targetIndex n word)
 14538	      (FixedPhaseDifferentialWord.eval n word f)}
 14539	  zero_mem' := by
 14540	    intro word
 14541	    rw [map_zero]
 14542	    exact IsInverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant.zero _
 14543	  add_mem' := by
 14544	    intro f g hf hg word
 14545	    rw [map_add]
 14546	    exact (hf word).add (hg word)
 14547	  smul_mem' := by
 14548	    intro c f hf word
 14549	    rw [map_smul]
 14550	    exact (hf word).smul c
 14551	
 14552	/-- Canonical fixed-phase core at orbit index `n`. -/
 14553	noncomputable abbrev InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n : ℤ) : Type :=
 14554	  ↥(inverseEtaFixedPhaseStableCoreSubmodule n)
 14555	
 14556	/-- Once the one-step covariance theorem has been proved, membership in the
 14557	all-word stable core is equivalent to the ordinary zeroth-word covariance
 14558	condition. -/
 14559	theorem mem_inverseEtaFixedPhaseStableCoreSubmodule_iff
 14560	    (n : ℤ) (f : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) :
 14561	    f ∈ inverseEtaFixedPhaseStableCoreSubmodule n ↔
 14562	      IsInverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant n f := by
 14563	  constructor
 14564	  · intro hf
 14565	    simpa using hf FixedPhaseDifferentialWord.nil
 14566	  · intro hf word
 14567	    exact word.eval_covariant hf
 14568	
 14569	/-! #### Natural invariant-cutoff test cores -/
 14570	
 14571	/-- Pointwise `Gamma(2)` invariance of a smooth quotient-compact cutoff. -/
 14572	def IsGammaTwoInvariantCutoff
 14573	    (cutoff : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) : Prop :=
 14574	  ∀ (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) (z : ℍ),
 14575	    (cutoff : ℍ → ℂ)
 14576	        ((((γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) : SL(2, ℤ)) • z)) =
 14577	      (cutoff : ℍ → ℂ) z
 14578	
 14579	/-- The raw product of an invariant test cutoff with an actual section at one
 14580	index of the fixed-phase orbit.  Quotient compactness comes entirely from the
 14581	cutoff; the section is only required to be real-smooth. -/
 14582	noncomputable def invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw
 14583	    (n : ℤ) (cutoff : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction)
 14584	    (orbitSection : InverseEtaPaperOrbitSection
 14585	      GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo n)
 14586	    (hSectionSmooth : RealSmooth (orbitSection : ℍ → ℂ)) :
 14587	    SmoothQuotientCompactFunction :=
 14588	  ⟨⟨(cutoff : ℍ → ℂ) * (orbitSection : ℍ → ℂ),
 14589	      cutoff.1.2.mul hSectionSmooth⟩,
 14590	    HasQuotientCompactSupport.mul_right cutoff.2
 14591	      (orbitSection : ℍ → ℂ)⟩
 14592	
 14593	@[simp]
 14594	theorem invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw_apply
 14595	    (n : ℤ) (cutoff : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction)
 14596	    (orbitSection : InverseEtaPaperOrbitSection
 14597	      GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo n)
 14598	    (hSectionSmooth : RealSmooth (orbitSection : ℍ → ℂ)) (z : ℍ) :
 14599	    (invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw n cutoff orbitSection
 14600	      hSectionSmooth : ℍ → ℂ) z =
 14601	        (cutoff : ℍ → ℂ) z * orbitSection z :=
 14602	  rfl
 14603	
 14604	/-- Zeroth-word covariance of the invariant-cutoff product. -/
 14605	theorem invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw_covariant
 14606	    (n : ℤ) (cutoff : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction)
 14607	    (hCutoffInvariant : IsGammaTwoInvariantCutoff cutoff)
 14608	    (orbitSection : InverseEtaPaperOrbitSection
 14609	      GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo n)
 14610	    (hSectionSmooth : RealSmooth (orbitSection : ℍ → ℂ)) :
 14611	    IsInverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant n
 14612	      (invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw n cutoff orbitSection
 14613	        hSectionSmooth) := by
 14614	  intro γ z
 14615	  change
 14616	    (cutoff : ℍ → ℂ) (((γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) :
 14617	        SL(2, ℤ)) • z) *
 14618	        orbitSection (((γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) :
 14619	          SL(2, ℤ)) • z) =
 14620	      (inverseEtaPaperOrbitMultiplier
 14621	          GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo n).factor γ z *
 14622	        ((cutoff : ℍ → ℂ) z * orbitSection z)
 14623	  rw [hCutoffInvariant γ z,
 14624	    WeightSection.covariance orbitSection γ z]
 14625	  ring
 14626	
 14627	/-- Every natural invariant-cutoff product lies in the all-word stable set;
 14628	this is a consequence of the proved one-step `R/L` covariance, not an extra
 14629	stability certificate. -/
 14630	theorem invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw_mem
 14631	    (n : ℤ) (cutoff : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction)
 14632	    (hCutoffInvariant : IsGammaTwoInvariantCutoff cutoff)
 14633	    (orbitSection : InverseEtaPaperOrbitSection
 14634	      GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo n)
 14635	    (hSectionSmooth : RealSmooth (orbitSection : ℍ → ℂ)) :
 14636	    invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw n cutoff orbitSection
 14637	        hSectionSmooth ∈
 14638	      inverseEtaFixedPhaseStableCoreSubmodule n :=
 14639	  (mem_inverseEtaFixedPhaseStableCoreSubmodule_iff n
 14640	    (invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw n cutoff orbitSection
 14641	      hSectionSmooth)).2
 14642	    (invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw_covariant n cutoff
 14643	      hCutoffInvariant orbitSection hSectionSmooth)
 14644	
 14645	/-- Typed natural test-core element obtained from an invariant cutoff and a
 14646	genuine smooth section at orbit index `n`. -/
 14647	noncomputable def invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSection
 14648	    (n : ℤ) (cutoff : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction)
 14649	    (hCutoffInvariant : IsGammaTwoInvariantCutoff cutoff)
 14650	    (orbitSection : InverseEtaPaperOrbitSection
 14651	      GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo n)
 14652	    (hSectionSmooth : RealSmooth (orbitSection : ℍ → ℂ)) :
 14653	    InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n :=
 14654	  ⟨invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw n cutoff orbitSection
 14655	      hSectionSmooth,
 14656	    invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw_mem n cutoff hCutoffInvariant
 14657	      orbitSection hSectionSmooth⟩
 14658	
 14659	@[simp]
 14660	theorem invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSection_apply
 14661	    (n : ℤ) (cutoff : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction)
 14662	    (hCutoffInvariant : IsGammaTwoInvariantCutoff cutoff)
 14663	    (orbitSection : InverseEtaPaperOrbitSection
 14664	      GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo n)
 14665	    (hSectionSmooth : RealSmooth (orbitSection : ℍ → ℂ)) (z : ℍ) :
 14666	    (invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSection n cutoff hCutoffInvariant orbitSection
 14667	        hSectionSmooth).1 z =
 14668	        (cutoff : ℍ → ℂ) z * orbitSection z :=
 14669	  rfl
 14670	
 14671	/-- Exact nonvanishing criterion for the natural product.  In particular, no
 14672	unsupported claim that every orbit index already has a nonzero seed section
 14673	is made: a common point where both supplied factors are nonzero is sufficient. -/

  6400	noncomputable def descendInvariant {E : Type*} (ρ : ℍ → E)
  6401	    (hρ : ∀ g : GammaTwoEffective, ∀ z, ρ (g • z) = ρ z) :
  6402	    GammaTwoQuotient → E :=
  6403	  Quotient.lift ρ (by
  6404	    intro a b hab
  6405	    rcases hab with ⟨g, rfl⟩
  6406	    exact hρ g b)

  6410	    (hρ : ∀ g : GammaTwoEffective, ∀ z, ρ (g • z) = ρ z)

  6415	/-- Support of an invariant function after descent is exactly the projected
  6416	upstairs support. -/
  6417	theorem descendInvariant_support {E : Type*} [Zero E]
  6418	    (ρ : ℍ → E)
  6419	    (hρ : ∀ g : GammaTwoEffective, ∀ z, ρ (g • z) = ρ z) :
  6420	    Function.support (descendInvariant ρ hρ) =
  6421	      gammaTwoQuotientMk '' Function.support ρ := by

  6428	    change descendInvariant ρ hρ (gammaTwoQuotientMk z) ≠ 0 at hz
  6429	    simpa only [Function.mem_support, descendInvariant_mk] using hz
  6430	  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hEq⟩

  6432	      simpa only [Function.mem_support, descendInvariant_mk] using hw

  6455	    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

  6462	
  6463	/-! #### Three-cusp geometry and the closed modular-tile truncation
  6464	
  6465	The open measured carrier above is the right object for integration, but it
  6466	omits its side-pairing boundary.  A cusp truncation used pointwise must instead
  6467	start with closed modular tiles.  The construction below is independent of the
  6468	topological compact exhaustion later in this namespace: it is the finite union
  6469	of the sets `r • ModularGroup.truncatedFundamentalDomain Y`, one for every
  6470	right coset of `Gamma(2)`.
  6471	
  6472	There are three quotient cusps, represented by `∞`, `0`, and `1`.  The
  6473	matrices `1`, `S`, and `T*S` are fixed as their scaling matrices.  The fourth
  6474	The endpoint `-1` of the usual closed polygon is another representative of the cusp
  6475	class of `1`; its scaling matrix is `T⁻¹*S`.  Thus the two finite endpoints of
  6476	that class differ by the width-two translation `T²`.
  6477	-/
  6478	
  6479	/-- The three cusp classes of `Gamma(2)`. -/
  6480	inductive GammaTwoCusp where
  6481	  | atInfinity
  6482	  | zero
  6483	  | one
  6484	deriving DecidableEq
  6485	
  6486	instance gammaTwoCuspFintype : Fintype GammaTwoCusp where
  6487	  elems := {.atInfinity, .zero, .one}
  6488	  complete x := by cases x <;> simp
  6489	
  6490	/-- Explicit integral scaling matrices taking `∞` to the named cusp. -/
  6491	def gammaTwoCuspScaling : GammaTwoCusp → SL(2, ℤ)
  6492	  | .atInfinity => 1
  6493	  | .zero => ModularGroup.S
  6494	  | .one => ModularGroup.T * ModularGroup.S
  6495	
  6496	@[simp]
  6497	theorem gammaTwoCuspScaling_atInfinity :
  6498	    gammaTwoCuspScaling .atInfinity = 1 :=
  6499	  rfl
  6500	
  6501	@[simp]
  6502	theorem gammaTwoCuspScaling_zero :
  6503	    gammaTwoCuspScaling .zero = ModularGroup.S :=
  6504	  rfl
  6505	
  6506	@[simp]
  6507	theorem gammaTwoCuspScaling_one :
  6508	    gammaTwoCuspScaling .one = ModularGroup.T * ModularGroup.S :=
  6509	  rfl
  6510	
  6511	/-- Every cusp of `Gamma(2)` has width two. -/
  6512	def gammaTwoCuspWidth (_ : GammaTwoCusp) : ℕ :=
  6513	  2
  6514	
  6515	@[simp]
  6516	theorem gammaTwoCuspWidth_eq_two (κ : GammaTwoCusp) :
  6517	    gammaTwoCuspWidth κ = 2 :=
  6518	  rfl
  6519	
  6520	/-- The width-two parabolic at the cusp `κ`, with an arbitrary integral
  6521	power. -/
  6522	def gammaTwoCuspTranslation (κ : GammaTwoCusp) (n : ℤ) : SL(2, ℤ) :=
  6523	  gammaTwoCuspScaling κ * ModularGroup.T ^ (2 * n) *
  6524	    (gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹
  6525	
  6526	/-- Width-two translations at all three cusps really belong to `Gamma(2)`. -/
  6527	theorem gammaTwoCuspTranslation_mem (κ : GammaTwoCusp) (n : ℤ) :
  6528	    gammaTwoCuspTranslation κ n ∈ GammaTwo := by
  6529	  have hdiv : (2 : ℤ) ∣ 2 * n := ⟨n, rfl⟩
  6530	  have hT : ModularGroup.T ^ (2 * n) ∈ GammaTwo := by
  6531	    simpa using
  6532	      CongruenceSubgroup.ModularGroup_T_pow_mem_Gamma
  6533	        (2 : ℤ) (2 * n) hdiv
  6534	  simpa [gammaTwoCuspTranslation, mul_assoc] using
  6535	    (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma_normal 2).conj_mem
  6536	      (ModularGroup.T ^ (2 * n)) hT (gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)
  6537	
  6538	/-- The unit translation is not a level-two matrix. -/
  6539	theorem modularGroup_T_not_mem_gammaTwo :
  6540	    ModularGroup.T ∉ GammaTwo := by
  6541	  rw [CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma_mem]
  6542	  norm_num [ModularGroup.T]
  6543	
  6544	/-- Conjugating a unit translation to any named cusp does not put it in
  6545	`Gamma(2)`. -/
  6546	theorem gammaTwoCuspUnitTranslation_not_mem (κ : GammaTwoCusp) :
  6547	    gammaTwoCuspScaling κ * ModularGroup.T *
  6548	      (gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹ ∉ GammaTwo := by
  6549	  intro h
  6550	  have hback :=
  6551	    (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma_normal 2).conj_mem _ h
  6552	      (gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹
  6553	  have hT : ModularGroup.T ∈ GammaTwo := by
  6554	    simpa [mul_assoc] using hback
  6555	  exact modularGroup_T_not_mem_gammaTwo hT
  6556	
  6557	/-- Width two is minimal among positive natural translation lengths. -/
  6558	theorem gammaTwoCuspWidth_minimal
  6559	    (κ : GammaTwoCusp) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
  6560	    (hnw : n < gammaTwoCuspWidth κ) :
  6561	    gammaTwoCuspScaling κ * ModularGroup.T ^ n *
  6562	      (gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹ ∉ GammaTwo := by
  6563	  have hn1 : n = 1 := by
  6564	    simp only [gammaTwoCuspWidth] at hnw
  6565	    omega
  6566	  subst n
  6567	  simpa using gammaTwoCuspUnitTranslation_not_mem κ
  6568	
  6569	/-- Local cusp height in the coordinate supplied by the scaling matrix. -/
  6570	noncomputable def gammaTwoCuspHeight (κ : GammaTwoCusp) (z : ℍ) : ℝ :=
  6571	  ((gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹ • z).im
  6572	
  6573	theorem gammaTwoCuspHeight_pos (κ : GammaTwoCusp) (z : ℍ) :
  6574	    0 < gammaTwoCuspHeight κ z :=
  6575	  UpperHalfPlane.im_pos _
  6576	
  6577	theorem gammaTwoCuspHeight_continuous (κ : GammaTwoCusp) :
  6578	    Continuous (gammaTwoCuspHeight κ) := by
  6579	  change Continuous (fun z : ℍ =>
  6580	    ((((Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))
  6581	      ((gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹)) • z).im))
  6582	  exact UpperHalfPlane.continuous_im.comp
  6583	    (continuous_const_smul
  6584	      ((Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))
  6585	        ((gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹)))
  6586	
  6587	theorem gammaTwoCuspHeight_measurable (κ : GammaTwoCusp) :
  6588	    Measurable (gammaTwoCuspHeight κ) :=
  6589	  (gammaTwoCuspHeight_continuous κ).measurable
  6590	
  6591	/-- The local height is periodic under the full width-two cusp stabilizer. -/
  6592	theorem gammaTwoCuspHeight_translation
  6593	    (κ : GammaTwoCusp) (n : ℤ) (z : ℍ) :
  6594	    gammaTwoCuspHeight κ (gammaTwoCuspTranslation κ n • z) =
  6595	      gammaTwoCuspHeight κ z := by
  6596	  simp only [gammaTwoCuspHeight, gammaTwoCuspTranslation, mul_smul,
  6597	    inv_smul_smul, ModularGroup.im_T_zpow_smul]

  6492	  | .atInfinity => 1
  6493	  | .zero => ModularGroup.S
  6494	  | .one => ModularGroup.T * ModularGroup.S
  6495	
  6496	@[simp]
  6497	theorem gammaTwoCuspScaling_atInfinity :
  6498	    gammaTwoCuspScaling .atInfinity = 1 :=
  6499	  rfl
  6500	
  6501	@[simp]
  6502	theorem gammaTwoCuspScaling_zero :
  6503	    gammaTwoCuspScaling .zero = ModularGroup.S :=
  6504	  rfl
  6505	
  6506	@[simp]
  6507	theorem gammaTwoCuspScaling_one :
  6508	    gammaTwoCuspScaling .one = ModularGroup.T * ModularGroup.S :=
  6509	  rfl
  6510	
  6511	/-- Every cusp of `Gamma(2)` has width two. -/
  6512	def gammaTwoCuspWidth (_ : GammaTwoCusp) : ℕ :=
  6513	  2
  6514	
  6515	@[simp]
  6516	theorem gammaTwoCuspWidth_eq_two (κ : GammaTwoCusp) :
  6517	    gammaTwoCuspWidth κ = 2 :=
  6518	  rfl
  6519	
  6520	/-- The width-two parabolic at the cusp `κ`, with an arbitrary integral
  6521	power. -/
  6522	def gammaTwoCuspTranslation (κ : GammaTwoCusp) (n : ℤ) : SL(2, ℤ) :=
  6523	  gammaTwoCuspScaling κ * ModularGroup.T ^ (2 * n) *
  6524	    (gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹
  6525	
  6526	/-- Width-two translations at all three cusps really belong to `Gamma(2)`. -/
  6527	theorem gammaTwoCuspTranslation_mem (κ : GammaTwoCusp) (n : ℤ) :
  6528	    gammaTwoCuspTranslation κ n ∈ GammaTwo := by
  6529	  have hdiv : (2 : ℤ) ∣ 2 * n := ⟨n, rfl⟩
  6530	  have hT : ModularGroup.T ^ (2 * n) ∈ GammaTwo := by
  6531	    simpa using
  6532	      CongruenceSubgroup.ModularGroup_T_pow_mem_Gamma
  6533	        (2 : ℤ) (2 * n) hdiv
  6534	  simpa [gammaTwoCuspTranslation, mul_assoc] using
  6535	    (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma_normal 2).conj_mem
  6536	      (ModularGroup.T ^ (2 * n)) hT (gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)
  6537	
  6538	/-- The unit translation is not a level-two matrix. -/
  6539	theorem modularGroup_T_not_mem_gammaTwo :
  6540	    ModularGroup.T ∉ GammaTwo := by
  6541	  rw [CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma_mem]
  6542	  norm_num [ModularGroup.T]
  6543	
  6544	/-- Conjugating a unit translation to any named cusp does not put it in
  6545	`Gamma(2)`. -/
  6546	theorem gammaTwoCuspUnitTranslation_not_mem (κ : GammaTwoCusp) :
  6547	    gammaTwoCuspScaling κ * ModularGroup.T *
  6548	      (gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹ ∉ GammaTwo := by
  6549	  intro h
  6550	  have hback :=
  6551	    (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma_normal 2).conj_mem _ h
  6552	      (gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹
  6553	  have hT : ModularGroup.T ∈ GammaTwo := by
  6554	    simpa [mul_assoc] using hback
  6555	  exact modularGroup_T_not_mem_gammaTwo hT
  6556	
  6557	/-- Width two is minimal among positive natural translation lengths. -/
  6558	theorem gammaTwoCuspWidth_minimal
  6559	    (κ : GammaTwoCusp) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
  6560	    (hnw : n < gammaTwoCuspWidth κ) :
  6561	    gammaTwoCuspScaling κ * ModularGroup.T ^ n *
  6562	      (gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹ ∉ GammaTwo := by
  6563	  have hn1 : n = 1 := by
  6564	    simp only [gammaTwoCuspWidth] at hnw
  6565	    omega
  6566	  subst n
  6567	  simpa using gammaTwoCuspUnitTranslation_not_mem κ
  6568	
  6569	/-- Local cusp height in the coordinate supplied by the scaling matrix. -/
  6570	noncomputable def gammaTwoCuspHeight (κ : GammaTwoCusp) (z : ℍ) : ℝ :=
  6571	  ((gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹ • z).im
  6572	
  6573	theorem gammaTwoCuspHeight_pos (κ : GammaTwoCusp) (z : ℍ) :
  6574	    0 < gammaTwoCuspHeight κ z :=
  6575	  UpperHalfPlane.im_pos _
  6576	
  6577	theorem gammaTwoCuspHeight_continuous (κ : GammaTwoCusp) :
  6578	    Continuous (gammaTwoCuspHeight κ) := by
  6579	  change Continuous (fun z : ℍ =>
  6580	    ((((Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))
  6581	      ((gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹)) • z).im))
  6582	  exact UpperHalfPlane.continuous_im.comp
  6583	    (continuous_const_smul
  6584	      ((Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))
  6585	        ((gammaTwoCuspScaling κ)⁻¹)))
  6586	
  6587	theorem gammaTwoCuspHeight_measurable (κ : GammaTwoCusp) :
  6588	    Measurable (gammaTwoCuspHeight κ) :=
  6589	  (gammaTwoCuspHeight_continuous κ).measurable
  6590	
  6591	/-- The local height is periodic under the full width-two cusp stabilizer. -/
  6592	theorem gammaTwoCuspHeight_translation
  6593	    (κ : GammaTwoCusp) (n : ℤ) (z : ℍ) :
  6594	    gammaTwoCuspHeight κ (gammaTwoCuspTranslation κ n • z) =
  6595	      gammaTwoCuspHeight κ z := by
  6596	  simp only [gammaTwoCuspHeight, gammaTwoCuspTranslation, mul_smul,
  6597	    inv_smul_smul, ModularGroup.im_T_zpow_smul]
  6598	
  6599	/-- Four ideal ends of the standard closed polygon; `one` and `negOne`
  6600	represent the same quotient cusp. -/
  6601	inductive GammaTwoCuspEnd where
  6602	  | atInfinity
  6603	  | zero
  6604	  | one
  6605	  | negOne
  6606	deriving DecidableEq
  6607	
  6608	instance gammaTwoCuspEndFintype : Fintype GammaTwoCuspEnd where
  6609	  elems := {.atInfinity, .zero, .one, .negOne}
  6610	  complete x := by cases x <;> simp
  6611

   116	lemma σ_sq (g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (z : ℂ) : σ g (σ g z) = z := by
   117	  simp only [σ]

   119	
   120	lemma σ_im_ne_zero {g z} : (σ g z).im ≠ 0 ↔ z.im ≠ 0 := by

   124	lemma σ_mul (g g' : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (z : ℂ) : σ (g * g') z = σ g (σ g' z) := by
   125	  simp only [σ, map_mul, Units.val_mul]
   126	  rcases g.det_ne_zero.lt_or_gt with (h | h) <;>
   127	  rcases g'.det_ne_zero.lt_or_gt with (h' | h')
   128	  · simp [mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg h h', h.not_gt, h'.not_gt]
   129	  · simp [(mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h h').not_gt, h.not_gt, h']
   130	  · simp [(mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg h h').not_gt, h, h'.not_gt]
   131	  · simp [mul_pos h h', h, h']

   141	/-- Fractional linear transformation, also known as the Moebius transformation -/
   142	def smulAux' (g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ := σ g (num g z / denom g z)

   144	lemma smulAux'_im (g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
   145	    (smulAux' g z).im = |g.det.val| * z.im / Complex.normSq (denom g z) := by
   146	  simp only [smulAux', σ]
   147	  split_ifs with h <;>
   148	  [rw [abs_of_pos h]; rw [abs_of_nonpos (not_lt.mp h)]] <;>
   149	  simpa only [Complex.conjCAE_apply, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im,
   150	    neg_mul, neg_div, neg_inj] using! moebius_im g z
   151	
   152	/-- Fractional linear transformation, also known as the Moebius transformation -/
   153	def smulAux (g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (z : ℍ) : ℍ :=
   154	  mk (smulAux' g z) <| by
   155	    rw [smulAux'_im]
   156	    exact div_pos (mul_pos (abs_pos.mpr g.det.ne_zero) z.im_pos) (normSq_denom_pos _ z.im_ne_zero)
   157	
   158	lemma denom_cocycle' (g h : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (z : ℍ) :
   159	    denom (g * h) z = σ h (denom g (smulAux h z)) * denom h z := by
   160	  simpa [smulAux, smulAux', denom, σ_sq] using denom_cocycle g h z.im_ne_zero
   161	
   162	theorem mul_smul' (g h : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (z : ℍ) :
   163	    smulAux (g * h) z = smulAux g (smulAux h z) := by
   164	  ext : 1
   165	  simp only [smulAux, coe_mk, smulAux', map_div₀, σ_num, σ_denom, σ_mul]
   166	  generalize hu : σ g (σ h z) = u
   167	  have hu : u.im ≠ 0 := by simpa only [← hu, σ_im_ne_zero] using! z.im_ne_zero
   168	  have hu' : (num h u / denom h u).im ≠ 0 := by
   169	    rw [moebius_im]
   170	    exact div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero h.det_ne_zero hu) (normSq_denom_ne_zero _ hu)
   171	  rw [div_eq_div_iff (denom_ne_zero_of_im _ hu) (denom_ne_zero_of_im _ hu'),
   172	    denom, mul_div, div_add' _ _ _ (denom_ne_zero_of_im _ hu), mul_div]
   173	  conv_rhs => rw [num]
   174	  rw [mul_div, div_add' _ _ _ (denom_ne_zero_of_im _ hu), div_mul_eq_mul_div]
   175	  congr 1
   176	  simp only [num, denom, Units.val_mul, mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
   177	    Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Finset.sum_singleton, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one,
   178	    Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_mul]
   179	  ring
   180	
   181	/-- Action of `GL (Fin 2) ℝ` on the upper half-plane, with `GL(2, ℝ)⁺` acting by Moebius
   182	transformations in the usual way, extended to all of `GL (Fin 2) ℝ` using complex conjugation. -/

   288	theorem coe_specialLinearGroup_apply {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Algebra R ℝ] (g : SL(2, R)) (z : ℍ) :
   289	    ↑(g • z) =
   290	      (((algebraMap R ℝ (g 0 0) : ℂ) * z + (algebraMap R ℝ (g 0 1) : ℂ)) /
   291	      ((algebraMap R ℝ (g 1 0) : ℂ) * z + (algebraMap R ℝ (g 1 1) : ℂ))) := by
   292	  rw [MulAction.compHom_smul_def, coe_smul_of_det_pos (by simp)]
   293	  rfl
   294	
   295	theorem specialLinearGroup_apply {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Algebra R ℝ] (g : SL(2, R)) (z : ℍ) :
   296	    g • z = mk
   297	      (((algebraMap R ℝ (g 0 0) : ℂ) * z + (algebraMap R ℝ (g 0 1) : ℂ)) /
   298	      ((algebraMap R ℝ (g 1 0) : ℂ) * z + (algebraMap R ℝ (g 1 1) : ℂ)))
   299	      (coe_specialLinearGroup_apply g z ▸ (g • z).im_pos) := by
   300	  ext; simp [coe_specialLinearGroup_apply]
   301	
   302	/-! these next few lemmas are *not* flagged `@simp` because of the constructors on the RHS;
   303	instead we use the versions with coercions to `ℂ` as simp lemmas instead. -/
   304	
   305	theorem modular_S_smul (z : ℍ) :
   306	    ModularGroup.S • z = mk (-z : ℂ)⁻¹ z.im_inv_neg_coe_pos := by
   307	  rw [specialLinearGroup_apply]
   308	  simp [ModularGroup.S, neg_div, inv_neg]
   309	
   310	theorem modular_T_zpow_smul (z : ℍ) (n : ℤ) : ModularGroup.T ^ n • z = (n : ℝ) +ᵥ z := by
   311	  rw [UpperHalfPlane.ext_iff, coe_vadd, add_comm, coe_specialLinearGroup_apply]
   312	  simp [ModularGroup.coe_T_zpow,
   313	    of_apply, cons_val_zero, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul, cons_val_one,
   314	    zero_mul, zero_add, div_one]
   315	
   316	theorem modular_T_smul (z : ℍ) : ModularGroup.T • z = (1 : ℝ) +ᵥ z := by
   317	  simpa only [zpow_one, Int.cast_one] using modular_T_zpow_smul z 1

   319	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
   320	theorem exists_SL2_smul_eq_of_apply_zero_one_eq_zero (g : SL(2, ℝ)) (hc : g 1 0 = 0) :
   321	    ∃ (u : { x : ℝ // 0 < x }) (v : ℝ), (g • · : ℍ → ℍ) = (v +ᵥ ·) ∘ (u • ·) := by
   322	  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, rfl⟩ := g.fin_two_exists_eq_mk_of_apply_zero_one_eq_zero hc
   323	  refine ⟨⟨_, mul_self_pos.mpr ha⟩, b * a, ?_⟩
   324	  ext1 ⟨z, hz⟩; ext1
   325	  suffices ↑a * z * a + b * a = b * a + a * a * z by simpa [specialLinearGroup_apply, add_mul]
   326	  ring
   327	
   328	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
   329	theorem exists_SL2_smul_eq_of_apply_zero_one_ne_zero (g : SL(2, ℝ)) (hc : g 1 0 ≠ 0) :
   330	    ∃ (u : { x : ℝ // 0 < x }) (v w : ℝ),
   331	      (g • · : ℍ → ℍ) =
   332	        (w +ᵥ ·) ∘ (ModularGroup.S • · : ℍ → ℍ) ∘ (v +ᵥ · : ℍ → ℍ) ∘ (u • · : ℍ → ℍ) := by
   333	  have h_denom (z : ℍ) := denom_ne_zero g z
   334	  induction g using Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.fin_two_induction with | _ a b c d h => ?_
   335	  replace hc : c ≠ 0 := by simpa using! hc
   336	  refine ⟨⟨_, mul_self_pos.mpr hc⟩, c * d, a / c, ?_⟩
   337	  ext1 ⟨z, hz⟩; ext1
   338	  suffices (↑a * z + b) / (↑c * z + d) = a / c - (c * d + ↑c * ↑c * z)⁻¹ by
   339	    simpa [modular_S_smul, coe_specialLinearGroup_apply]
   340	  replace hc : (c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by norm_cast
   341	  replace h_denom : ↑c * z + d ≠ 0 := by simpa using! h_denom ⟨z, hz⟩
   342	  replace h : (a * d - b * c : ℂ) = (1 : ℂ) := by norm_cast
   343	  grind
   344	
   345	end SLAction

   347	section toSL2R
   348	
   349	/-- Map from `ℍ` to `SL(2, ℝ)`, giving a continuous section of the map `g ↦ g • I`. -/
   350	noncomputable def toSL2R (z : ℍ) : SL(2, ℝ) :=
   351	  ⟨!![√z.im, z.re / √z.im; 0, 1 / √z.im], by
   352	    simp [mul_inv_cancel₀ (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr z.im_pos)]⟩
   353	
   354	lemma toSL2R_apply (z : ℍ) : z.toSL2R =
   355	  ⟨!![√z.im, z.re / √z.im; 0, 1 / √z.im], by
   356	    simp [mul_inv_cancel₀ (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr z.im_pos)]⟩ := (rfl)
   357	
   358	@[simp] lemma coe_toSL2R (z : ℍ) : z.toSL2R = !![√z.im, z.re / √z.im; 0, 1 / √z.im] := (rfl)
   359	
   360	@[simp] lemma toSL2R_smul_I (z : ℍ) : z.toSL2R • I = z := by
   361	  have : √z.im ≠ (0 : ℂ) := by simpa [Real.sqrt_ne_zero'] using z.im_pos
   362	  ext
   363	  suffices z.re / √z.im + √z.im * Complex.I = z * (↑√z.im)⁻¹ by
   364	    rw [coe_specialLinearGroup_apply, div_eq_iff (mod_cast denom_ne_zero z.toSL2R I)]
   365	    simpa [add_comm]
   366	  rw [div_add' (hc := this), mul_right_comm, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Real.sqrt_mul z.im_pos.le,
   367	    Real.sqrt_mul_self z.im_pos.le, re_add_im, div_eq_mul_inv]
   368	
   369	/-- `SL(2, ℝ)` acts transitively on the upper half-plane. -/
   370	instance isPretransitiveSL2R : MulAction.IsPretransitive SL(2, ℝ) ℍ :=
   371	  .of_orbit fun z ↦ ⟨_, toSL2R_smul_I z⟩
   372	
   373	/-- `GL(2, ℝ)` acts transitively on the upper half-plane. -/
   374	instance isPretransitiveGL2R : MulAction.IsPretransitive (GL (Fin 2) ℝ) ℍ :=
   375	  .of_smul_eq ((↑) : SL(2, ℝ) → _) fun {g z} ↦ (MulAction.compHom_smul_def _ g z).symm
   376	
   377	end toSL2R

   379	section J
   380	
   381	/-- The matrix `[-1, 0; 0, 1]`, which defines an anti-holomorphic involution of `ℍ` via
   382	`τ ↦ -conj τ`. -/
   383	def J : GL (Fin 2) ℝ := .mkOfDetNeZero !![-1, 0; 0, 1] (by simp)
   384	
   385	lemma coe_J_smul (τ : ℍ) : (↑(J • τ) : ℂ) = -conj ↑τ := by
   386	  simp [UpperHalfPlane.coe_smul, σ, J, show ¬(1 : ℝ) < 0 by simp, num, denom]
   387	
   388	@[simp] lemma val_J : J.val = !![-1, 0; 0, 1] := rfl
   389	
   390	@[simp] lemma J_sq : J ^ 2 = 1 := by ext; simp [J, sq, Matrix.one_fin_two]
   391	
   392	@[simp] lemma det_J : J.det = -1 := by ext; simp [J]
   393	
   394	@[simp] lemma sigma_J : σ J = Complex.conjCAE := by simp [σ, J]
   395	
   396	@[simp] lemma denom_J (τ : ℂ) : denom J τ = 1 := by simp [J, denom]
   397	
   398	@[simp]
   399	lemma denom_J_mul (g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (τ : ℂ) : denom (J * g) τ = denom g τ := by
   400	  simp [denom, vecMul, vecHead, vecTail]
   401	
   402	end J
   403	
   404	end UpperHalfPlane
